audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads [Singed, Skill, Mordekaiser x5] on both layers while the packet says [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Singed, Mordekaiser, Singed, Singed] — and the mirror (audits/top/singed__mordekaiser) already landed on exactly the packet's shape. The page's own whys agree with the packet too: whys[0] 'neither of you commits', whys[3] 'his kiting beats your slow approach', whys[5] 'you rarely catch him', whys[6] 'out-runs and out-sustains'.
audit.why: Restating the mirror from this side: levels 1 is a standoff, 2-3 are Mordekaiser's once Indestructible and Darkness Rise are online, 4-5 go to Singed because a dashless Mordekaiser cannot chase a proxy, level 6 is Mordekaiser's on Realm of Death, and from first item on Singed's move speed and drain-tank scaling take it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Mordekaiser, Level 3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 Singed, Level 6 Mordekaiser, First item Singed, 2+ items Singed. Matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes and they match the mirror's list: Lvl 2 Q+E window, Lvl 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), 1st item, 2+ items drain-tank Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup appears nowhere on the page: Insanity Potion (R, 100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts the Indestructible heal-back that the whole Mordekaiser pattern is built on. The page instead tells you to 'bank a W shield before pressing R' without ever saying his R is what turns that shield off. Fling's condition is also unstated — Riot's text: a target flung into Mega Adhesive is ROOTED, not merely slowed.
audit.why: It changes the sequencing from 'bait his flip' to 'trade before he drinks'. It is also the exact item _missing/mordekaiser.json flags for this matchup (rule their-antiheal-blunts-you), and the mirror recorded it from Singed's side.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion is 100s flat and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — force your extended trade and your W heal before he drinks. Fling is 125 range on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and roots you if it lands you in Mega Adhesive (1000 range, 17-13s, which also grounds).

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags: NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. 'His flip. Bait it, then R.' carries no numbers.
audit.why: Fling 10-8s, Insanity Potion 100s and Realm of Death 140-100s are the three clocks the lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Trade before Insanity Potion (100s); step outside Fling's 125 range and commit once it is spent (10-8s).

notes: Chart flipped to the packet, which is also exactly what the already-audited mirror (singed__mordekaiser) settled on — the two sides now agree row for row. The high-value addition is the _missing-interactions item that had never reached the page: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail blunts Indestructible, so the trade has to happen before he drinks. Same recurring kit bug noted by the mirror and by my other mordekaiser matchups: Obliterate carries a 'grounding' flag Riot's description does not support; I wrote no grounding claim, which matters here because Singed's Mega Adhesive genuinely does ground and a reader could be misled into thinking the interaction runs both ways.
